note: Held-out prompts: never read when editing a skill. See evals/README.md.

evals.prompt: Add an admin action to adjust a customer's credit limit, in src/limits.py.
evals.expected_output: An append-only audit entry with actor, time, old and new value and reason, the change rejected without a reason, approval for large changes, and tests.
expectations: Writes an append-only audit record with actor, timestamp, previous value, new value and reason
Rejects an adjustment without a reason or an identified actor
Requires approval or a second person above a threshold
Tests that the audit record exists after the change and that the record cannot be updated or deleted

evals.prompt: Compliance asks who changed the fee schedule in March and what it looked like before. Our fee table only has updated_at. See src/fee_table.py.
evals.expected_output: States that the current schema cannot answer, adds an append-only history with before and after values and actor, is honest that the past cannot be backfilled, and tests the new history.
expectations: States that updated_at alone cannot answer who changed what or the prior value
Adds an append-only history or event table with actor, time, before and after, written in the same transaction as the change
Says plainly that history before the change cannot be reconstructed from the table
Writes tests that a fee change produces a history row and that history rows are immutable
